boundary_cases.judgment: Hotels and car hire are reported aggregator capabilities, not adopted goals in this flight-focused discussion.
CO2, airline and stop filters are described as available; personal use or maintenance intent is not established for each.
The best-tab algorithm description is not the respondent adopting all its ranking criteria.
Better alerts are a hedged possibility with strong limitations; the actual limited alert goal is captured from T087.
Capabilities of Kayak and Google Flights are comparison background; they are not all separate requested features.
Skyscanner itself does not perform the final booking; do not invent an in-Skyscanner payment goal.
